<h1 id="fb2e366a-0caa-4b15-a95a-7aae39712b37" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">一、目前国内接入最常见、最有代表性的 4 类光伏设备</h1>
<p>&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116094431.png" alt="image.png" width="833" data-align="left"></span></p>
<h1 id="2205f016-c539-4de2-9335-901006b12faa" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>二、华为 SUN2000 逆变器通讯报文示例</strong></h1>
<p class="p1">这是一个<strong>标准 Modbus TCP 请求报文</strong>：</p>
<p>00 01 00 00 00 06 01 03 75 30 00 06</p>
<p class="p1">含义：</p>
<p class="p1">Modbus TCP 报文由两部分组成：</p>
<p class="p1">MBAP Header（7字节） + PDU（功能码 + 数据）</p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116094919.png" alt="image.png" width="784" data-align="left"></p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095000.png" alt="image.png" width="785" data-align="left"></p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095106.png" alt="image.png" width="785" data-align="left"></p>
<p class="p1">在光伏逆变器里，这类请求通常用于：</p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095130.png" alt="image.png" width="505" data-align="left"></p>
<p><strong>响应</strong></p>
<p>这是一个标准的Modbus TCP 响应报文结构</p>
<p>00 01 00 00 00 0F 01 03 0C 09 C4 00 64 13 88 00 32</p>
<p class="p1">MBAP Header（7字节） + PDU（功能码 + 数据）</p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095300.png" alt="image.png" width="580" data-align="left"></p>
<p>PDU数据解析</p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095417.png" alt="image.png" width="572" data-align="left"><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095352.png" alt="image.png" width="576" data-align="left"></p>
<p>结合光伏业务的数值换算</p>
<p class="p1">厂家协议通常定义 <strong>倍率（Scale）</strong>：</p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095454.png" alt="image.png" width="591" data-align="left"></p>
<p>最终物模型字段赋值示例</p>
<p>{ “dcVoltage”: 250.0, “dcCurrent”: 10.0, “dcPower”: 5.0, “internalTemp”: 50 }</p>
<h1 id="f304e5ae-3f04-4a41-a4be-c8e60f804f55" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">三、示例代码</h1>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>报文请求构造 → 响应报文解析 → 寄存器解码 → 光伏设备物模型组织</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="p1">目标：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><strong>协议层、解析层、物模型层解耦</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">方便后续做 <strong>多品牌 Adapter + 配置化映射</strong></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>代码结构</p>
<p><img src="https://resource.teld.org/teldimage/101/image20260116095740.png" alt="image.png" width="350" data-align="left"></p>
<h2 id="a6eafc45-6352-4934-be5d-626f569811ee"><strong>1、Modbus TCP 请求报文构造</strong></h2>
<p class="p2"><strong>ModbusRequest.cs</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-auto">public class ModbusRequest
{
    public ushort TransactionId { get; set; }
    public byte UnitId { get; set; }
    public byte FunctionCode { get; set; } = 0x03;
    public ushort StartAddress { get; set; }
    public ushort Quantity { get; set; }

    public byte[] ToBytes()
    {
        var buffer = new List&lt;byte&gt;();

        // Transaction ID
        buffer.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(TransactionId).Reverse());

        // Protocol ID (0x0000)
        buffer.Add(0x00);
        buffer.Add(0x00);

        // Length = UnitId + PDU
        ushort length = 1 + 1 + 2 + 2;
        buffer.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(length).Reverse());

        // Unit ID
        buffer.Add(UnitId);

        // PDU
        buffer.Add(FunctionCode);
        buffer.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(StartAddress).Reverse());
        buffer.AddRange(BitConverter.GetBytes(Quantity).Reverse());

        return buffer.ToArray();
    }
}</code></pre>
<h2 id="895c43c7-2f86-4508-9506-a46a7b7c0499"><strong>2. Modbus TCP 响应解析</strong></h2>
<p class="p1"><strong>ModbusResponse.cs</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-auto">public class ModbusResponse
{
    public ushort TransactionId { get; set; }
    public byte UnitId { get; set; }
    public byte FunctionCode { get; set; }
    public byte ByteCount { get; set; }
    public byte[] Data { get; set; }
}</code></pre>
<h3 id="7bdc7b40-6efc-47c5-98a5-fc5df2a23743"><strong>ModbusParser.cs</strong></h3>
<pre><code class="language-auto">public static class ModbusParser
{
    public static ModbusResponse ParseResponse(byte[] response)
    {
        if (response.Length &lt; 9)
            throw new Exception("Invalid Modbus response length");

        var result = new ModbusResponse();

        result.TransactionId = ReadUInt16(response, 0);
        ushort protocolId = ReadUInt16(response, 2);
        ushort length = ReadUInt16(response, 4);

        if (protocolId != 0)
            throw new Exception("Invalid Protocol ID");

        result.UnitId = response[6];
        result.FunctionCode = response[7];
        result.ByteCount = response[8];

        result.Data = response.Skip(9).Take(result.ByteCount).ToArray();

        return result;
    }

    private static ushort ReadUInt16(byte[] buffer, int index)
    {
        return (ushort)((buffer[index] &lt;&lt; 8) | buffer[index + 1]);
    }
}</code></pre>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="8d252688-3fa5-4971-bc3c-ffffdfe64a4c"><strong>3. 寄存器解码（倍率 + 字节序）</strong></h2>
<p class="p2"><strong>RegisterDecoder.cs</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-auto">public static class RegisterDecoder
{
    public static ushort ReadUInt16(byte[] data, int registerIndex)
    {
        int offset = registerIndex * 2;
        return (ushort)((data[offset] &lt;&lt; 8) | data[offset + 1]);
    }

    public static double ReadScaledValue(
        byte[] data,
        int registerIndex,
        double scale)
    {
        return ReadUInt16(data, registerIndex) / scale;
    }
}</code></pre>
<h2 id="4cdd911c-5fa7-4365-8d9d-a56ecf790ca0"><strong>4、光伏设备物模型定义</strong></h2>
<p class="p2"><strong>PvThingModel.cs</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-auto">public class PvThingModel
{
    public double DcVoltage { get; set; }
    public double DcCurrent { get; set; }
    public double DcPower { get; set; }
    public double InternalTemperature { get; set; }

    public DateTime Timestamp { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
}</code></pre>
<h2 id="003ffa63-3819-4c8d-9a29-505a581bf28f"><strong>5. 从响应到物模型的映射</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-auto">public static class PvThingModelBuilder
{
    public static PvThingModel FromModbus(ModbusResponse response)
    {
        var data = response.Data;

        return new PvThingModel
        {
            DcVoltage = RegisterDecoder.ReadScaledValue(data, 0, 10),     // 30000
            DcCurrent = RegisterDecoder.ReadScaledValue(data, 1, 10),     // 30001
            DcPower = RegisterDecoder.ReadScaledValue(data, 2, 1000),     // 30002
            InternalTemperature = RegisterDecoder.ReadUInt16(data, 3)     // 30003
        };
    }
}</code></pre>
<h2 id="d3638961-f015-4550-afc5-d0c991937f10"><strong>6. 完整示例调用（Demo）</strong></h2>
<pre><code class="language-auto">public class Demo
{
    public static void Run()
    {
        // 1. 构造请求
        var request = new ModbusRequest
        {
            TransactionId = 1,
            UnitId = 1,
            StartAddress = 30000,
            Quantity = 6
        };

        byte[] requestBytes = request.ToBytes();

        // === 这里通常通过 TCP Socket 发送 requestBytes ===

        // 2. 模拟接收到的响应报文
        byte[] responseBytes =
        {
            0x00,0x01,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x0F,0x01,0x03,0x0C,
            0x09,0xC4,0x00,0x64,0x13,0x88,0x00,0x32
        };

        // 3. 解析响应
        var response = ModbusParser.ParseResponse(responseBytes);

        // 4. 构建物模型
        PvThingModel model = PvThingModelBuilder.FromModbus(response);

        Console.WriteLine($"DC Voltage: {model.DcVoltage} V");
        Console.WriteLine($"DC Current: {model.DcCurrent} A");
        Console.WriteLine($"DC Power: {model.DcPower} kW");
        Console.WriteLine($"Temperature: {model.InternalTemperature} ℃");
    }
}</code></pre>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
